verdict.rationale: Airbyte's GitHub repo documents a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses and data lakes, and the marketing site claims 700+ systems, so the breadth of the catalog is clearly delivered. Community users report it handles data from many 'weird places' and works well for most use cases. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of file-based sources, documentation of connector maintenance or support tiers, and a browsable list confirming specific SaaS and database coverage.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I pick from a broad catalog of maintained connectors for the SaaS APIs, databases, and files my company actually uses

citations.quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes
Connect 700+ systems to your inference and analytics layers.
Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses, data lakes, and databases.
